sections.preamble: You are an expert coding assistant operating inside pi, a coding agent harness. You help users by reading files, executing commands, editing code, and writing new files.
sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- bash: Execute bash commands (ls, grep, find, etc.)
- edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement, including multiple disjoint edits in one call
- write: Create or overwrite files
- grep: Search file contents for patterns (respects .gitignore)
- find: Find files by glob pattern (respects .gitignore)
- ls: List directory contents

In addition to the tools above, you may have access to other custom tools depending on the project.
</tools>
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- You can inspect PI_* environment variables for current model and session details.
- Use edit for precise changes (edits[].oldText must match exactly)
- When changing multiple separate locations in one file, use one edit call with multiple entries in edits[] instead of multiple edit calls
- Each edits[].oldText is matched against the original file, not after earlier edits are applied. Do not emit overlapping or nested edits. Merge nearby changes into one edit.
- Keep edits[].oldText as small as possible while still being unique in the file. Do not pad with large unchanged regions.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: bash
toolsAdded.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

toolsAdded.name: grep
toolsAdded.description: Search file contents for a pattern. Returns matching lines with file paths and line numbers. Respects .gitignore. Output is truncated to 100 matches or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Long lines are truncated to 500 chars.

path.description: Directory or file to search (default: current directory)

glob.description: Filter files by glob pattern, e.g. '*.ts' or '**/*.spec.ts'

literal.description: Treat pattern as literal string instead of regex (default: false)

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (default: 0)

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default: 100)

toolsAdded.name: find
toolsAdded.description: Search for files by glob pattern. Returns matching file paths relative to the search directory. Respects .gitignore. Output is truncated to 1000 results or 50KB (whichever is hit first).

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match files, e.g. '*.ts', '**/*.json', or 'src/**/*.spec.ts'

path.description: Directory to search in (default: current directory)

toolsAdded.name: ls
toolsAdded.description: List directory contents. Returns entries sorted alphabetically, with '/' suffix for directories. Includes dotfiles. Output is truncated to 500 entries or 50KB (whichever is hit first).

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default: 500)

- `el-dialog` 的内容走 `<teleport to="body">`，`renderToString` 只留 `<!---->` → 对话框内部根本没被渲染。
  用立即渲染的 `ElDialog`/`ElUpload` 替身接管，**替身必须尊重 `modelValue`**，而且必须
  `app.component()` 全局注册：对话框现在是子组件，局部 `components` 注册不会被子组件继承。
- Vue 的 SSR 会**吞掉渲染错误**：render 里抛 TypeError 时 `renderToString` 照样 resolve，
  只留 `<!---->`。所以“没抛异常”不算测到了，得断言捕获到的 `[error]` 为空。
  往 `ImportDialog.vue` 里注入 `:max-height="t.nope.n"` 验证过这道闸确实会红。

# R 分析界面共享层

新增一个分析功能（还剩 GMR⁴、Bayesian ERA）时按这里的方式接，不要复制粘贴视图代码。

## 文件职责

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `r-analysis.css` | **自动生成，不要手改**。由 `r-scripts/tools/extract_ra_styles.mjs` 从 `views/r-analysis/PERMANOVA_Med.vue` 的 `<style scoped>` 抽取，选择器统一限定在 `.ra-shell` 内 |
| `AnalysisHeader.vue` | 页头（标题 / 副标题 / 返回首页） |
| `AnalysisToolbar.vue` | 侧边工具栏容器；按钮由父视图通过默认插槽给（三个分析的按钮语义不同，组件里不塞业务） |
| `DataTemplateSelector.vue` | 「设计模板」区：分组 + 折叠 + 当前选中摘要 + 清除 |
| `ChartPanel.vue` | 图表区外壳：tab + 容器 ref + 空态；ECharts 实例由视图创建（`getHost()` 拿 DOM） |
| `ResultCard.vue` / `StatGrid.vue` / `InfoGrid.vue` | 结果区卡片 / 关键统计量网格 / 信息网格 |
| `TemplateButton.vue` / `TemplateCategory.vue` | 旧的**公式**模板按钮（`PERMANOVA.vue`、`PERMANOVA_Med.vue` 在用） |
| `ToolbarActions.vue` | 侧边栏四个动作（下载模板/导入数据/导出结果/下载输入）：图标、配色、禁用条件 | 只 emit，不含业务 |
| `ImportDialog.vue` | 导入外壳：说明 → 选文件 → 错误/警告 → 预览 tabs → 用户点「填入表单」 | 只认 `sheets` / `tabs` |
| `ExportDialog.vue` | 导出勾选外壳 | 只认 `options` / `selected` |

## 三层切法（导入导出别再往视图里堆）

三个模块的导入导出看起来“其实不一样”，但不一样的是**声明**，不是流程：

| 层 | 内容 | 位置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| L1 原语 | 读写工作簿、表名别名、`mapWorkbook`（按主表 ID 对齐 + 缺表拒绝 + 形状警告）、`previewFromFields`、`writeWorkbook` | `utils/sheetIo.js` |
| L2 外壳 | 工具栏四个按钮、导入对话框、导出对话框 | `components/r-analysis/*.vue`（本目录） |
| L3 声明 | 要哪几张表、导出项清单与 `build()/data()`、`planExport`、`toFormPatch` | `utils/<name>SheetSpec.js` |

**硬规定**：L3 必须是纯数据 + 纯函数，不碰 DOM、不 import file-saver。视图只负责把 L3 算出来的
任务表执行掉。为什么：以前 `build()` 写在视图 methods 里，“导出内容对不对”只能人肉开 Excel 数格子；
抽成 `planExport(keys, ctx, stamp)` 后，[test_nr_spec.mjs](../../../r-scripts/tools/test_nr_spec.mjs)
能直接断言“结论对比里 p 是真数”“没有一行第二列是空的”“PCoA 行数 = 样本数”。

**不要把三个模块合成一个带 `if (module === 'med')` 的大对话框**：分支会越长越肥，
任何模块的新需求都要动共用组件，等于把三个模块焊在同一文件里。

  只留 `<!---->` 占位。所以冒烟测试必须把 `errorHandler` / `console.error` 捕获到的东西也算失败，

3. **导入的「填入表单」必须关对话框 + 没解析时给错。** 只写 `if (!imported) return;`
   又不关窗，用户看到的就是“点了没反应”（Non-random 实机报的就是这条）。
4. **`el-upload` 配 `:limit="1"` + `:auto-upload="false"` 时，第二次选文件根本不会触发 `on-change`。**
   Element Plus 的 `uploadFiles` 是这么写的：
   `if (limit && fileList.length + files.length > limit) { onExceed(files, fileList); return; }`。
   而 `show-file-list="false"` 又让人看不见那个残留文件，`onExceed` 默认是空函数 ⇒ 彻底静默。
   这就是“上传完模板后点填入表单没反应”的真因（三个模块共用外壳，所以三个一起中招）。
   `ImportDialog` 现在同时做了两件事：`on-exceed` 里 `clearFiles()` 后把新文件照原路 emit（后选覆盖先选），
   以及 `watch modelValue` 在**打开时**清队列。`test_import_shell.mjs` 直接跑组件的 methods/watch，
   不需要浏览器；把 `:on-exceed` 摘掉它就是红的。
5. **示例数据有统计下限，不是“有几行算几行”**（都是实测，不是猜）：

   | 模块 | 示例设计 | 实测结果 |
   | --- | --- | --- |
   | PERMANOVA | 8 样本（4 Control + 4 Treatment），组内 0.05~0.10、组间 0.32~0.48 | `p=0.014`、`F=40.4`（旧 5 样本：`p=0.53`） |
   | Non-random | 12 样本 = **3 批次 × 每批 2 Case + 2 Control** | `p_free=0.0071`、`p_constrained=0.0103`、`feasible_blocks=3` |
   | PERMANOVA-med | 20 样本，Y3/M4/X1/Z2（协变量带小数） | `success`、中介 `p=0.0198`、协变量真的进模型 |

   Non-random 旧模板是 6 样本、每批 **1 Case + 1 Control**：把所有批次标签同时翻转得到的置换
   与观测设计完全同构 ⇒ 零分布退化、**p 下界约 0.25，效应再强也不会显著**（实测 `p_free=1`、`p_constrained=1`）。
   每批 2:2 才有 `C(4,2)^3 = 216` 个置换（约 108 个等价类，p 下界 ≈ 0.009）。
   这三个“模板→导入→真跑 R”现在都是固定断言（`test_pm_view` 5b / `test_nr_view` 9 / `test_med_view` 4）。
6. **示例数据属于各自的 L3，不属于 L1。** `sheetIo.buildTemplateSheets()` 已删，
   Non-random 的示例回到 `nrTemplateSheets()`。L1 只留下两个命名原语：
   `fileStamp()`（`2026-11-18-03-25-18`，不带冒号也不带 `T`）与
   `templateFilename(slug, stamp)` → `<slug> 数据模板_<stamp>.xlsx`。
   以前三个模块三种写法（无时间戳会互相覆盖、`_数据模板` 与下划线混用、两种时间戳格式）。

另：R 里拼字符串只能用 `paste0`。写 `"甲" + "乙"` 不会提示语法错，而是在**报错分支里**

#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# nonrandom_permanova.R 的统计正确性校验
#
# 1) 单因子 F / R2 必须与 vegan::adonis2 完全一致（受限置换整套逻辑建立在这之上）
# 2) 多因子时逐术语给边际检验，与「只用该术语的单因子模型」一致
# 3) 连续协变量必须被明确拒绝 —— 早先版本让它通过，算出一个能跑但不能看的 F
#    （pH 与区组相关 0.011，却把 group 的 F 从 19.3 压到 1.5）
# 4) controlCoverage 走「相对丰度归一化」，不重采样、可复现
# 5) vegdist_ws 满足距离的基本性质（本机 vegan 2.7.6 没有 ws 方法，故自实现）
#
# 用法：Rscript r-scripts/tools/verify_nonrandom_engine.R [script.R]
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!exists("%||%")) `%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
fails <- 0
ok <- function(label, cond, detail = "") {
  pass <- isTRUE(cond)
  if (!pass) fails <<- fails + 1
  d <- if (length(detail) == 0 || !nzchar(detail[1])) "" else paste0("  ", detail[1])
  cat(sprintf("  %-56s %s%s\n", label, if (pass) "✅" else "❌", d))
}
# adonis2 的列名跨版本不一样（F / F.Model / `F model`），按前缀取，别写死
col_of <- function(a, pat) {
  nm <- grep(pat, names(a), value = TRUE)
  if (!length(nm)) stop(paste0("adonis2 输出里没有列匹配 ", pat, "；实际列：", paste(names(a), collapse = ", ")))
  a[[nm[1]]]
}
close_to <- function(a, b, tol = 1e-8) is.numeric(a) && is.numeric(b) && length(a) && !is.na(a[1]) && max(abs(a - b), na.rm = TRUE) < tol

content.thinking:
**My diagnostic rule is wrong.** Look: 9 of 26 teaching templates fire it, including `noSignal` (a template whose *purpose* is "no real effect") and `spatialField`/`estuaryTransect` (spatial schemes). The message text even says "只有 **999** 个互不相同的统计量" — i.e. the null is perfectly diverse! So my trigger is misreading the situation.

Why? My rule is `p_floor = mean(f_null >= f_obs) > 0.05`. But `p_floor` as I defined it is **not a floor** — it's the *observed fraction* of the null exceeding the observed statistic. For a design with **no real effect**, most permutations exceed F_obs → mean(...) ≈ 0.5 → my rule calls it "degenerate, p can't get below 0.5". That's nonsense: with a null-ish design, p≈0.5 is simply "no effect", not "no freedom to test".

The true degeneracy property is: **many permutations are *identical* to the observed design (same F because they're the same assignment)**, i.e. `distinct_f` very small relative to permutations. My `distinct_f <= 6` clause (which I removed!) was the right half; `p_floor` is not a floor at all.

Correct formulation:
- Let `m = #{ i : f_null[i] == f_obs }` (exact ties, including permutations that reproduce the observed assignment).
- The minimum achievable p (as B→∞) is `(m + 1)/(B + 1)` → asymptotic tie fraction: `tie_frac = mean(f_null == f_obs)`. If `tie_frac > 0.05`, p can never go below ~0.05 — that's a genuine floor.

上一轮我修的是「DOM 还没挂载」。真正还有第二种失败模式，而且它更贴合「只有这个 tab 空白」：

**ECharts 在 `clientWidth/Height === 0` 的容器上 `init` 不报错、`setOption` 也不报错，只是画出一个看不见的空图**；等到下一次 `resize()`（就是你切 tab 那一下）才补上尺寸。结果区是 `v-if` 刚出现的，同一帧里元素存在但布局还没算完——于是「画了，但看不见」。

另外还有一个结构性脆弱：`activeChart` 默认就是 `'null'`（零分布对比），跑完 stratified 分析时代码把它再赋一次 `'null'` → **watcher 不触发**，整条路只剩 `runAnalysis` 里那一次性 `$nextTick` 的运气。

2. `drawWhenReady`：`setOption` 后下一帧再 `resize()` 一次，并自己 `chart.getWidth()` 复核；宽度是 0 就返回 `empty:true`。
3. **三个视图都改成数据驱动重画**：`watch: chartData` / `analysisResult` → 重画，不再只赌那一帧。

结果：拿不到容器 / 量不出尺寸 / 画成 0 宽，**三种情况现在都会给你一句话**，不再有「空白但无任何提示」这种状态。PERMANOVA 的画图路径顺手删了 5 行 `console.log('[Chart] Result:', result)`（整份结果打印在生产路径上）。

## 你看到的 26% / 0.257 是抽样估计，真值是 25% / 0.250
那句「999 次置换里有 26% 与观测设计算出同一个 F」是我拿 Monte-Carlo 数的：置换数不同就会漂——

| permutations | 报出的并列比例 |
| --- | --- |
| 999 | 27% |
| 4999 | 25% |
| 9999 | 25% |

而这个设计的**精确**答案是 `2/8 = 25%`：3 个区组、每块 1 Case + 1 Control ⇒ 可达指派 `2³ = 8` 个，其中与观测同构的（原地 + 全部翻转）2 个。

现在直接算组合数，不再抽样：

```
并列比例 = 2 · ∏ k_b!(n_b−k_b)! / ∏ n_b!        （用 lfactorial 防溢出）
```

于是那句话变成：**「25% 的置换与观测设计算出完全相同的 F（不同取值只有 4 个），因此 p 的下界就是 0.250」**——`下界约` 也改成了 `下界就是`，因为它现在是定理不是估计。

这个差别不是洁癖：报「约 0.27」会让人以为把置换数从 999 提到 9999 就有机会显著，**而实际上永远到不了 25% 以下**。同一公式对每批 2:2 算出 `2·(2!2!/4!)³ ≈ 0.93%` ⇒ 不报提醒，与 26 个教学模板的实测（`p_con=0.001`）完全一致，仍然 0 误报。

## 顺便确认第一条
「零分布对比」初次分析直接画出来了 ✓。三条路径都被堵上：DOM 晚到（有界等几帧）、容器存在但量不出尺寸（ECharts 不报错只画空图，现在也算「没就绪」+ 事后 `getWidth()===0` 自检出 `empty`）、以及最关键的——三个视图改成**数据驱动重画**（`watch: chartData / analysisResult`），不再只赌 `runXxx` 里那一次性 `$nextTick`（首次分析时 `activeChart` 压根没变，watcher 不会触发，旧代码只剩运气）。

## 证据
```
16 套件 954 项全绿（test_nr_view 94 含「下界必须是精确 0.250」这条新断言）
verify_nonrandom_templates 26/26 ✓   verify_med_templates 25/25 ✓   npm run build ✓
精确公式三例交叉验证：1:1 → 25%（实测 p=0.271→收敛 0.250）；2:2 → 0.93% 不报；3:3 → 不报
```

全部真机验证过了，我建议分 6 组（都还只在本地，`HEAD = 14340a3`，领先 origin 19 未 push）：

4. `feat(nr engine)`: 退化设计 diagnostics（精确组合下界）+ 三个模板可跑通 + Med 引擎下限/常量列/饱和设计/错误透出
5. `test`: 新增 `test_chart_host` / `test_import_shell` / `test_med_render` + 三条端到端「下载模板→导入→真跑 R」
6. `docs`: README 六条硬规定 + 覆盖清单

要我现在执行，还是先把 GMR⁴ / Bayesian ERA 的活儿接着往下推（那两条还挂着占位实现 + 各 25 个模板的欠账）？

summary:
## Goal
Fix three UI/functionality bugs in the Electron-Egg R analysis app (PERMANOVA-med, Non-random PERMANOVA, and template naming) while maintaining strict test coverage and avoiding commits.

## Progress
### Done
- [x] **PERMANOVA-med Template Fix**: Replaced 2-sample template with a 20-sample deterministic dataset that passes LDM permutation tests (p<0.05). Updated `frontend/src/utils/medSheetSpec.js`.
- [x] **Engine Guardrails**: Updated `r-scripts/permanova_med.R` to reject n<6 samples with clear errors and added saturation checks for covariates. Fixed string concatenation bugs in error messages.
- [x] **Non-random Import Dialog**: Fixed "no reaction" on upload by adding `showImportDialog = false` in `applyImport()` and handling `on-exceed` in `ImportDialog.vue`. Updated `frontend/src/views/r-analysis/Nonrandom_PERMANOVA.vue`.
- [x] **Empty Input Handling**: Modified `matrixInput.js` to return `{empty: true}` instead of JSON parse errors for blank inputs, preventing premature error displays on page load.
- [x] **Template Naming Standardization**: Implemented `templateFilename()` and `fileStamp()` in `sheetIo.js` to enforce uniform filename format `<slug> 数据模板_<timestamp>.xlsx` across all modules.

- 新增 diagnostics：受限置换零分布退化时明确开口。
  判据用**精确组合值**：并列比例 = 2·∏ k_b!(n_b−k_b)! / ∏ n_b!。

# PERMANOVA 分析脚本
# 使用 vegan 包的 adonis2 函数

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)

if (length(args) < 3) {
  stop("Usage: Rscript permanova.R <input.json> <output.json> <error.txt>")
}

input_file <- args[1]
output_file <- args[2]
error_file <- args[3]

tryCatch({
  # 读取输入参数
  params <- jsonlite::fromJSON(input_file)
  
  # 检查必需包
  required_packages <- c("jsonlite", "vegan")
  for (pkg in required_packages) {
    if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE)) {
      stop(paste("Required package not installed:", pkg))
    }
  }
  
  # 提取参数
  cat("[PERMANOVA.R] Starting analysis...\n")
  
  # 确保距离矩阵是数值型 matrix
  distance_matrix_raw <- params$distanceMatrix
  
  # 如果是 list（来自 JSON），转换为 matrix
  if (is.list(distance_matrix_raw)) {
    cat("[PERMANOVA.R] Converting list to matrix...\n")
    # 先转换为向量，再转换为 matrix
    distance_vector <- unlist(distance_matrix_raw, use.names = FALSE)
    
    n_rows <- length(distance_matrix_raw)
    n_cols <- length(distance_matrix_raw[[1]])
    
    distance_matrix <- matrix(
      as.numeric(distance_vector),
      nrow = n_rows,
      ncol = n_cols,
      byrow = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    distance_matrix <- as.matrix(distance_matrix_raw)
  }
  
  cat("[PERMANOVA.R] Distance matrix:", nrow(distance_matrix), "x", ncol(distance_matrix), "\n")
  
  permutations <- params$permutations
  if (is.null(permutations)) permutations <- 999

  # 置换检验种子：默认 12345，保证「同输入 => 同输出」
  seed_value <- params$seed
  if (is.null(seed_value)) seed_value <- 12345L
  set.seed(as.integer(seed_value))

function unwrapRError(err) {
  let msg = String((err && err.message) || err || '未知错误');

  return msg.replace(/^\\s*[:：]\\s*/, '').trim();
}'''

## Goal
Fix three UI/functionality bugs in the Electron-Egg R analysis app (PERMANOVA-med, Non-random PERMANOVA, and template naming) while maintaining strict test coverage and avoiding commits.

## Progress
### Done
- [x] **PERMANOVA-med Template Fix**: Replaced 2-sample template with a 20-sample deterministic dataset that passes LDM permutation tests (p<0.05). Updated `frontend/src/utils/medSheetSpec.js`.
- [x] **Engine Guardrails**: Updated `r-scripts/permanova_med.R` to reject n<6 samples with clear errors and added saturation checks for covariates. Fixed string concatenation bugs in error messages.
- [x] **Non-random Import Dialog**: Fixed "no reaction" on upload by adding `showImportDialog = false` in `applyImport()` and handling `on-exceed` in `ImportDialog.vue`. Updated `frontend/src/views/r-analysis/Nonrandom_PERMANOVA.vue`.
- [x] **Empty Input Handling**: Modified `matrixInput.js` to return `{empty: true}` instead of JSON parse errors for blank inputs, preventing premature error displays on page load.
- [x] **Template Naming Standardization**: Implemented `templateFilename()` and `fileStamp()` in `sheetIo.js` to enforce uniform filename format `<slug> 数据模板_<timestamp>.xlsx` across all modules.
- [x] **Test Coverage**: Added end-to-end tests verifying templates can be downloaded, imported, and run successfully via R. All 14 harness suites pass (800+ assertions).

### In Progress
- [ ] **Final Verification**: Confirming build stability after recent regex fixes in test harnesses.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Key Decisions
- **Deterministic Templates**: Downloadable templates must contain valid data that produces significant results when run, not just format examples.
- **LDM Constraints**: Enforced minimum sample size (n>=6) and permutation count multiples of 100 based on empirical sweeps.
- **Unified File Stamps**: Centralized timestamp generation in `sheetIo.js` to ensure consistent file naming across Vue views.

## Next Steps
1. Run full test suite (`node r-scripts/tools/test_*.mjs`) to confirm green status after regex adjustments.
2. Verify `npm run build` succeeds.
3. Present final diff summary to user for review before committing.

## Critical Context
- **Files**: `frontend/src/utils/medSheetSpec.js`, `frontend/src/utils/nonrandomSheetSpec.js`, `frontend/src/utils/sheetIo.js`, `r-scripts/permanova_med.R`, `frontend/src/components/r-analysis/ImportDialog.vue`.
- **Commands**: `node r-scripts/tools/test_med_view.mjs`, `node r-scripts/tools/test_nr_view.mjs`, `cd frontend && npm run build`.
- **Constraints**: Do not commit yet; maintain portable R compatibility (v4.3.3/4.6.1); ensure LDM mediation tests pass with p<0.05 for demo data.

## Goal
Fix bugs in an Electron-Egg R analysis application (PERMANOVA, Non-random PERMANOVA, Mediation) and implement missing features. Specifically: resolve chart rendering issues on first analysis, handle degenerate statistical designs with warnings, and prepare for GMR4/Bayesian ERA implementation which requires external dependencies.

## Constraints & Preferences
- **Context**: The user manually pushes to GitHub due to network restrictions on the AI's environment.
- **Dependencies**: Internal network blocks package downloads; user will download via hotspot if provided a list.
- **Documentation**: `development-doc/` must be included in version control.
- **Quality**: Tests must verify actual behavior (e.g., "mutation testing" where removing a fix makes tests fail). No silent failures.

## Progress
### Done
- [x] **Chart Rendering Fix**: Created `frontend/src/utils/chartHost.js` to handle DOM timing issues (waiting for non-zero sized containers) and updated three views (`Nonrandom_PERMANOVA.vue`, `PERMANOVA_Med.vue`, `PERMANOVA.vue`) to use data-driven re-rendering (`watch`).
- [x] **Degenerate Design Diagnostics**: Updated `r-scripts/nonrandom_permanova.R` to calculate exact combinatorial lower bounds for p-values in stratified designs (e.g., 1 Case + 1 Control per block) and output `diagnostics`. Updated UI to display these warnings.
- [x] **Template Fixes**: Regenerated templates to ensure statistically significant results (PERMANOVA: 8 samples; Non-random: 12 samples; Med: 20 samples). Fixed file naming conventions using `fileStamp()` and `templateFilename()`.
- [x] **Shell/UI Fixes**: Fixed `el-upload` limit bug in `ImportDialog.vue` (second file selection now works), corrected scoped CSS issues, and fixed Excel export shapes in `sheetIo.js`.
- [x] **Commits**: 5 logical commits pushed locally (`d7c4844` to `fbc3ce9`). All 16 test suites pass (948 assertions).

### In Progress
- [ ] **Dependency Identification**: Analyzing which R packages are missing for GMR4 and Bayesian ERA modules.

### Blocked
- [ ] **GMR4/Bayesian ERA Implementation**: Requires R packages not currently installed or available in the portable runtime.

## Key Decisions
- **Exact Combinatorics for P-floor**: Replaced Monte Carlo estimation of p-value lower bounds with exact formula `2 * prod(k_b!(n_b-k_b)!)/prod(n_b!)` to avoid misleading users into thinking more permutations would yield significance.
- **Data-Driven Chart Rendering**: Switched from relying on `$nextTick` after analysis to watching `chartData`/`analysisResult` to ensure charts render even if initial DOM layout is delayed.
- **Scoped Styles Ownership**: Moved specific component styles (like `.headline-diagnostic`) into the views that actually use them, rather than sharing via generated CSS, to prevent dead code.

## Next Steps
1. Provide the user with the exact list of R packages needed for GMR4 and Bayesian ERA.
2. User downloads packages via hotspot and places them in `r-portable/library`.
3. Implement GMR4 engine logic (`r-scripts/gmr4.R`) and Bayesian ERA logic.
4. Create corresponding frontend views and import/export specs for new modules.

## Critical Context
- **Missing R Packages**: `mvtnorm`, `coda`, `bridgesampling`, `lme4`, `minqa`, `numDeriv`, `pbkrtest`, `emmeans`, `multcomp`, `truncnorm`, `pdfetch`, `sumhistnet`, `sandwich`, `lmtest`, `car`, `boot` (some already present, others missing). GMR4 likely needs `GMMOR` or similar interaction models; Bayesian ERA may need `rjags` or `rstan` (heavy compilation risks).
- **File Paths**:
    - Chart utility: `frontend/src/utils/chartHost.js`
    - NR Engine: `r-scripts/nonrandom_permanova.R`
    - Views: `frontend/src/views/r-analysis/*.vue`
    - Tests: `r-scripts/tools/test_*.mjs`
- **Git Status**: Local branch `master` is ahead of `origin/master` by 5 commits. Network timeout prevents push.

# GMR⁴ (Generalized Mixed Regularized Reduced Rank Regression) 脚本
# 基于 2025 年论文算法实现

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)

if (length(args) < 3) {
  stop("Usage: Rscript gmr4.R <input.json> <output.json> <error.txt>")
}

input_file <- args[1]
output_file <- args[2]
error_file <- args[3]

tryCatch({
  params <- jsonlite::fromJSON(input_file)
  
  # 检查必需包
  required_packages <- c("jsonlite", "Matrix", "glmnet")
  for (pkg in required_packages) {
    if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE)) {
      stop(paste("Required package not installed:", pkg))
    }
  }
  
  # 提取参数
  X <- as.matrix(params$X)  # 预测变量
  Y <- as.matrix(params$Y)  # 响应变量
  Z <- if (!is.null(params$Z)) as.matrix(params$Z) else NULL  # 协变量
  rank <- params$rank %||% 2
  lambda <- params$lambda %||% 0.1
  
  # GMR⁴ 核心算法（简化版，需根据论文完善）
  # 1. 数据标准化
  X_scaled <- scale(X)
  Y_scaled <- scale(Y)
  
  # 2. 奇异值分解获取初始秩
  svd_result <- svd(crossprod(X_scaled, Y_scaled))
  
  # 3. 正则化降秩回归
  # 使用交替最小化算法
  n <- nrow(X)
  p <- ncol(X)
  q <- ncol(Y)
  
  # 初始化 U 和 V
  U <- svd_result$u[, 1:rank, drop = FALSE]
  V <- svd_result$v[, 1:rank, drop = FALSE]
  
  # 交替优化（简化版本）
  for (iter in 1:100) {
    # 固定 V，更新 U
    UV <- U %*% t(V)
    coef_U <- solve(crossprod(X_scaled) + lambda * diag(p), crossprod(X_scaled, Y_scaled %*% V))
    U <- X_scaled %*% coef_U
    U <- qr.Q(qr(U))  # 正交化
    
    # 固定 U，更新 V
    coef_V <- solve(crossprod(Y_scaled) + lambda * diag(q), crossprod(Y_scaled, X_scaled %*% U))
    V <- Y_scaled %*% coef_V
    V <- qr.Q(qr(V))  # 正交化
    
    # 检查收敛
    if (iter > 1 && max(abs(U - U_old)) < 1e-6 && max(abs(V - V_old)) < 1e-6) {
      break
    }
    U_old <- U
    V_old <- V
  }
  
  # 计算最终系数矩阵
  B <- U %*% t(V)
  
  # 计算拟合值和残差
  Y_fitted <- X_scaled %*% B
  residuals <- Y_scaled - Y_fitted
  
  # 计算 R²
  SS_total <- sum((Y_scaled - mean(Y_scaled))^2)
  SS_residual <- sum(residuals^2)
  R2 <- 1 - SS_residual / SS_total
  
  output <- list(
    success = TRUE,
    coefficients = B,
    U = U,
    V = V,
    R2 = R2,
    rank = rank,
    lambda = lambda,
    iterations = iter
  )
  
  output_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(output, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 10, pretty = TRUE)
  writeLines(output_json, output_file)
  
}, error = function(e) {
  # as.character(error) 会连调用帧一起写出来（"Error in doTryCatch(return(expr), ...): 真消息"），
  # 那层噪声把真正的原因埋到最后面。取 conditionMessage，并留一行可追溯的脚本标记。
  writeLines(sprintf("[GMR4] %s", conditionMessage(e)), error_file)
  quit(status = 1)
})

arguments.content:
# ============================================================================
# GMR4 —— 广义多响应降秩回归（Generalized Multi-response Reduced-Rank Regression）
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 模型：  Y (n x q) ~ X (n x p) B ，约束 rank(B) = S <= min(p, q)
#         加岭正则 lambda：  min  ||Y - XB||_F^2 + lambda * ||B||_F^2
#
# 两阶段调参（对应论文 4.1 / 4.2 两步）：
#   Step 1  Rank-wise regularization tuning：对每个候选秩 S 单独调 lambda
#   Step 2  Global model selection via generalized SE rule：
#           在 CV 误差不超过「最优 + 1 个标准误」的那些 (S, lambda) 里，
#           选最简约的（S 最小，其次 lambda 最大）。这就是 1-SE 规则向二维超参的推广。
#
# 为什么不用 glmnet：岭 + 降秩这组约束有闭式解（Izenman 1975 的 RRR，把 Sxx^-1
# 换成 (Sxx + lambda*I)^-1 就是正则版本），写闭式而不是调用外部优化器有两个好处 ——
#   1) 能拿 OLS / 岭回归做**恒等式**校验（见 verify_gmr4_engine.R），不是"看起来差不多"；
#   2) 少一个需要编译的依赖。r-runtime.lock.json 里 gmr4 的 required 已相应改成 jsonlite + Matrix。
#
# 与旧脚本的关系（重要，别再把这段删掉）：
#   旧 gmr4.R 是"简化版，需根据论文完善"的占位，交替最小化里把 U/V 从 p x rank 的
#   系数因子重新赋值成 X %*% coef 这种 n x rank 的数据矩阵，第 2 轮迭代就
#   `solve()` 非兼容参数 —— 真 R 跑一次就 exit=1，也就是说这份脚本**从未成功执行过**，
#   却已经写进了 lockfile 的 required 表和 api/r.js 的封装里。闭式实现顺带消灭了这类维度事故。
# ============================================================================

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)

if (length(args) < 3) {
  stop("Usage: Rscript gmr4.R <input.json> <output.json> <error.txt>")
}

input_file  <- args[1]
output_file <- args[2]
error_file  <- args[3]

# ---- 数值内核：矩阵求逆一律走 chol / backsolve，不用 inverse() ----
# 本项目硬规定：inverse() 在病态设计上会给出"看起来是个矩阵"的垃圾数，
# chol2inv 失败则直接报错，报错比垃圾数字好。
safe_solve <- function(A, B = NULL, ridge = 0) {
  Areg <- A
  if (ridge > 0) Areg <- A + ridge * diag(nrow(A))
  out <- tryCatch(chol2inv(chol(as.matrix(Areg))), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(out)) {
    stop(sprintf(paste0("设计矩阵奇异（无法求逆，条件数极差）。",
                        "请检查是否有重复列、常量列，或样本数少于变量数（当前 %d 样本 / %d 列）。"),
                 nrow(A), ncol(A)), call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (is.null(B)) out else out %*% B
}

rrr_ridge_fit <- function(Xc, Yc, rank_s, lambda) {
  p <- ncol(Xc); q <- ncol(Yc)
  Sxx <- crossprod(Xc)                    # p x p
  Sxy <- crossprod(Xc, Yc)                # p x q
  Syy <- crossprod(Yc)                    # q x q

  B_ridge <- safe_solve(Sxx, Sxy, ridge = lambda)              # (X'X+λI)^-1 X'Y

  # 广义特征问题 M = Syy^-1 * Sxy' B —— 它的领先 S 个特征向量给出响应侧的投影方向 V。
  # Syy 半正定时加一个极小的岭，只为了让求逆稳定；不改变方向（有 verify 脚本盯住）。
  M <- safe_solve(Syy, crossprod(Sxy, B_ridge), ridge = 1e-8 * max(1, sum(diag(Syy)) / q))

  ev <- eigen(M, symmetric = FALSE)
  ord <- order(-Re(ev$values))            # 特征值理论上非负（= 正则化典范相关平方）
  V  <- Re(ev$vectors[, ord[seq_len(min(rank_s, q))], drop = FALSE])   # q x S

  # B = B_ridge V (V' Syy V)^-1 V' Syy —— 秩 S 且在岭度量下的最小二乘解
  G  <- safe_solve(crossprod(V, Syy %*% V))
  B  <- B_ridge %*% V %*% G %*% t(V) %*% Syy

  list(B = B, V = V, U = B_ridge %*% V, B_ridge = B_ridge)
}

tryCatch({
  params <- jsonlite::fromJSON(input_file)

  required_packages <- c("jsonlite", "Matrix")   # 闭式解不需要 glmnet（见文件头）
  for (pkg in required_packages) {
    if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE)) {
      stop(paste("Required package not installed:", pkg), call. = FALSE)
    }
  }

  diagnostics <- character(0)

  # ---------------- 输入解析与形状检查 ----------------
  as_num_matrix <- function(m, what) {
    if (is.null(m)) return(NULL)
    mm <- tryCatch(as.matrix(as.numeric(unlist(m))), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(mm)) stop(sprintf(paste0("%s 转不成数值矩阵 —— 表里有文本或空单元格。"), what), call. = FALSE)
    mm
  }
  X <- as_num_matrix(params$X, "预测变量 X")
  Y <- as_num_matrix(params$Y, "响应变量 Y")
  Z <- as_num_matrix(params$Z, "协变量 Z")
  if (is.null(X) || is.null(Y)) stop("必须同时提供 X（预测变量）与 Y（响应变量）", call. = FALSE)
  if (ncol(X) < 1L || ncol(Y) < 1L) stop("X 与 Y 都至少要有一列", call. = FALSE)
  if (nrow(X) == ncol(X) && !isTRUE(params$X_is_vectors)) {
    # 本项目栽过两次：矩阵被当成"样本×变量"表喂进来。形状可疑时必须开口，不能静默默认。
    stop(sprintf(paste0("X 是 %d x %d 的方阵 —— 看起来像距离矩阵而不是「样本 x 变量」表。",
                        "GMR4 要的是原始变量表（每行一个样本）。"), nrow(X), ncol(X)), call. = FALSE)
  }

  n <- nrow(X)
  if (nrow(Y) != n) {
    stop(sprintf("X 有 %d 行（样本），Y 有 %d 行 —— 两边样本数必须一致。", n, nrow(Y)), call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (!is.null(Z) && nrow(Z) != n) {
    stop(sprintf("协变量 Z 有 %d 行，与样本数 %d 不符。", nrow(Z), n), call. = FALSE)
  }

  p <- ncol(X); q <- ncol(Y)
  s_max <- min(p, q)
  if (n <= 2L) {
    stop(sprintf(paste0("样本数只有 %d。GMR4 要按 K 折交叉验证挑秩与 lambda，",
                        "至少需要 4 个样本（K=4 时每折训练集才有自由度）。"), n), call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (s_max < 2L) {
    diagnostics <- c(diagnostics, sprintf(paste0("min(p, q) = %d，秩没有可选空间（只有一个候选）。",
                                                 "结果等价于岭回归，降秩不起作用。"), s_max))
  }
  if (n <= p) {
    diagnostics <- c(diagnostics, sprintf(paste0("样本数 %d 不大于预测变量数 %d：",
                                                 "X'X+λI 在 λ 很小时接近奇异，秩与 lambda 的选型会不稳定。请增多样本或减少变量。"),
                                          n, p))
  }

  # ---------------- 常量列（零方差）：scale() 会算出 NaN，静默毁掉整条链 ----------------
  # Med 模块有先例：spec 里留常量列 + 引擎兜底报警。
  drop_col <- function(M, name) {
    v <- apply(M, 2, stats::sd, na.rm = TRUE)
    bad <- which(!is.finite(v) | v < .Machine$double.eps^0.5)
    if (length(bad)) {
      diagnostics <<- c(diagnostics, sprintf(paste0("%s 里有常量列（第 %s 列，方差为 0），已自动剔除；",
                                                    "如果那是你需要的变量，请检查是不是整列填了同一个值。"),
                                             name, paste(bad, collapse = ", ")))
      M <- M[, -bad, drop = FALSE]
    }
    M
  }
  X <- drop_col(X, "X"); p <- ncol(X)
  Y <- drop_col(Y, "Y"); q <- ncol(Y)
  if (!is.null(Z)) { Z <- drop_col(Z, "Z") }
  s_max <- min(p, q)

  # ---------------- 标准化 + 协变量偏正交化 ----------------
  mu_X <- colMeans(X); sd_X <- apply(X, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  mu_Y <- colMeans(Y)
  Xs <- scale(X, center = mu_X, scale = sd_X)          # 零方差列已剔除，不会出现 NaN
  Ys <- scale(Y, center = mu_Y, scale = apply(Y, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE))
  Xs[is.na(Xs)] <- 0
  Ys[is.na(Ys)] <- 0

  if (!is.null(Z) && ncol(Z) > 0) {
    # 残差化：把 Z 从 X 和 Y 里都扣掉（Frisch–Waugh），否则 Z 的效应会被算进 B。
    Zs <- scale(Z, center = colMeans(Z), scale = apply(Z, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE))
    Zs[is.na(Zs)] <- 0
    Pz <- safe_solve(crossprod(Zs) + 1e-8 * diag(ncol(Zs))) %*% t(Zs)   # q_Z x n
    Xs <- Xs - Zs %*% (Pz %*% Xs)
    Ys <- Ys - Zs %*% (Pz %*% Ys)
  }

  # ---------------- 超参候选 ----------------
  rank_grid <- unique(as.integer(c(1:s_max)))
  if (!is.null(params$ranks)) {
    rg <- as.integer(unlist(params$ranks))
    rank_grid <- sort(unique(rg[rg >= 1 & rg <= s_max]))
    if (length(rank_grid) == 0L) {
      diagnostics <- c(diagnostics, sprintf("你给的 ranks 没有一个落在 1..%d，改用全部候选。", s_max))

    }
  }
  lam_grid <- as.numeric(unlist(params$lambdas))
  if (length(lam_grid) == 0L) {
    lam_grid <- unique(round(10 ^ seq(-3, 2, length.out = 12), 6))     # 0.001 .. 100
  }
  kfold <- as.integer(params$kfold %||% 5L)
  kfold <- max(2L, min(kfold, n))
  seed  <- as.integer(params$seed %||% 12345L)     # 与 permanova.R 同一个纪律：同输入必同输出

  set.seed(seed)
  fold <- sample(rep_len(1:kfold, n))

  cv_mean <- matrix(NA_real_, length(rank_grid), length(lam_grid),
                    dimnames = list(paste0("S", rank_grid), paste0("lambda", lam_grid)))
  cv_se   <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(cv_mean), ncol(cv_mean), dimnames = dimnames(cv_mean))
  rss_grid <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(cv_mean), ncol(cv_mean), dimnames = dimnames(cv_mean))

  # 每折的误差用「该折行上的 SSE / 该折样本数」，对 q 求和 => 单一可比较的 CV 曲线下值
  for (i in seq_along(rank_grid)) {

      per_fold <- numeric(kfold)

        tr <- fold != k; te <- fold == k
        if (sum(tr) <= 1L || sum(te) == 0L) next
        fit <- rrr_ridge_fit(Xs[tr, , drop = FALSE], Ys[tr, , drop = FALSE], rank_grid[i], lam_grid[j])
        pred <- Xs[te, , drop = FALSE] %*% fit$B
        per_fold[k] <- sum((Ys[te, , drop = FALSE] - pred)^2) / sum(te)
      }
      used <- per_fold[per_fold > 0 | per_fold == 0]

      cv_se[i, j]   <- stats::sd(used) / sqrt(length(used))

  sel <- ok[ord_ok[1], , drop = FALSE]
  S_sel <- rank_grid[sel[1]]; lam_sel <- lam_grid[sel[2]]
  rule_note <- sprintf(paste0("按广义 1-SE 规则：CV=%.4f 的基准上允许 +1SE(%.4f)，",
                              "在 %d 个达标的 (S,lambda) 里取了最简约的 S=%d、lambda=%g。"),
                       cv_mean[best_idx[1], best_idx[2]], cv_se[best_idx[1], best_idx[2]],
                       nrow(ok), S_sel, lam_sel)

  final <- rrr_ridge_fit(Xs, Ys, S_sel, lam_sel)

  # ---------------- 拟合优度（原始尺度上给，别只给标准化尺度的） ----------------
  Yhat_s <- Xs %*% final$B                                  # 标准化尺度
  Yhat   <- sweep(Yhat_s * matrix(apply(Y, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE), n, q, byrow = TRUE) +
                    matrix(mu_Y, n, q, byrow = TRUE), 2, 0)  # 还原到 Y 的原尺度
  ss_tot <- colSums((Y - matrix(mu_Y, n, q, byrow = TRUE))^2)
  ss_res <- colSums((Y - Yhat)^2)
  r2_each <- ifelse(ss_tot > 0, 1 - ss_res / ss_tot, NA_real_)
  r2_total <- 1 - sum(ss_res) / sum(ss_tot)

  # 全秩对照：降秩一定让 RSS 变大；不成立就是实现错了（verify 脚本也盯这条）
  full_fit <- rrr_ridge_fit(Xs, Ys, s_max, lam_sel)
  rss_full <- sum((Ys - Xs %*% full_fit$B)^2)
  if (sum((Ys - Xs %*% final$B)^2) < rss_full - 1e-8) {
    diagnostics <- c(diagnostics, paste0("内部校验失败：秩 S=", S_sel,
                                         " 的残差平方和竟然小于全秩解，实现有 bug，请报告。"))
  }
  if (S_sel >= s_max) {
    diagnostics <- c(diagnostics, sprintf(paste0("最终选了 S=%d = min(p,q)，说明降秩没带来 CV 收益；",
                                                 "这份数据里各响应之间可能没有共享的低维结构。"), S_sel))
  }

  # ---------------- 输出契约 ----------------
  mk <- function(m) { if (is.null(m)) NULL else { d <- dimnames(m); dimnames(m) <- NULL; m } }
  output <- list(
    success = TRUE,
    method = "GMR4 (generalized multi-response reduced-rank ridge regression)",
    n_samples = n, p = p, q = q,
    rank_selected = S_sel, lambda_selected = lam_sel,
    rank_grid = rank_grid, lambda_grid = lam_grid,
    s_max = s_max, kfold = kfold, seed = seed,
    selection_rule = rule_note,
    coefficients = mk(final$B),          # p x q，标准化尺度
    coefficients_raw_scale = NULL,
    U = mk(final$U), V = mk(final$V),    # B = U V' 的因子形式
    R2 = r2_total,
    R2_per_response = as.numeric(r2_each),
    cv = list(mean = mk(as.matrix(cv_mean)), se = mk(as.matrix(cv_se)),
              best = c(rank = rank_grid[best_idx[1]], lambda = lam_grid[best_idx[2]],
                       value = cv_mean[best_idx[1], best_idx[2]])),
    rss_reduced = sum((Ys - Xs %*% final$B)^2),
    rss_full = rss_full,
    covariates_partialled_out = if (!is.null(Z)) ncol(Z) else 0,
    X_center = as.numeric(mu_X), X_scale = as.numeric(sd_X),
    Y_center = as.numeric(mu_Y),
    predicted = mk(Yhat),
    diagnostics = as.list(diagnostics),
    interpretation = sprintf(paste0("选了秩 S=%d（满秩是 %d）、lambda=%g。",
                                    "整体 R²=%.3f；各响应 R² 见 R2_per_response。",
                                    "若某响应 R² 明显低于其它，说明它不共享那个低维结构。"),
                             S_sel, s_max, lam_sel, r2_total)
  )

  # 非标准化尺度的系数：B_raw = (1/sd_Y) * B_std * sd_X' ，便于用户直接代回原始数据
  B_raw <- t((t(final$B) / apply(Y, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)) * sd_X)
  dimnames(B_raw) <- NULL
  output$coefficients_raw_scale <- B_raw

  cat(sprintf("[GMR4] n=%d p=%d q=%d -> S=%d lambda=%g R2=%.4f（诊断 %d 条）\n",
              n, p, q, S_sel, lam_sel, r2_total, length(diagnostics)))

  output_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(output, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 8, pretty = TRUE,
                                  null = "null")
  writeLines(output_json, output_file)

}, error = function(e) {
  writeLines(sprintf("[GMR4] %s", conditionMessage(e)), error_file)
  quit(status = 1)
})

cat > r-scripts/tools/verify_gmr4_engine.R <<'EOF'
# ============================================================================
# GMR4 引擎校验：只断言"闭式解必须是真"的东西，不比较小数点后的观感
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 用法：r-portable/bin/Rscript.exe r-scripts/tools/verify_gmr4_engine.R
# 退出码：0 = 全过；1 = 有失败项（装配脚本与 CI 据此红）
#
# 为什么值得这么写：gmr4.R 旧版是个从未成功执行过的占位（真跑 exit=1），
# 而"能跑"不等于"算对"。下面 10 条里有 3 条是恒等式级别的：
#   秩取满 + lambda=0 必须逐元素等于 OLS；秩取满必须等于岭解；RSS 随秩单调。
# 这三条一旦实现走样就必红，比任何截图都硬。
# ============================================================================

setwd(if (nzchar(Sys.getenv("PROJECT_ROOT"))) Sys.getenv("PROJECT_ROOT") else {
  # 从 r-scripts/tools/ 回到项目根
  d <- normalizePath(file.path(dirname(sys.frame(1)$ofile %||% ".")), mustWork = FALSE)
  if (file.exists("r-scripts/gmr4.R")) getwd() else setwd("../../"); getwd()
})

RSCRIPT <- file.path(R.home("bin"), "Rscript.exe")
GMR4    <- "r-scripts/gmr4.R"
TMP     <- file.path(tempdir(), "gmr4_verify"); dir.create(TMP, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

pass <- 0L; fails <- character(0)
ok   <- function(cond, msg, detail = "") {
  if (isTRUE(cond)) { pass <<- pass + 1L; cat(sprintf("  \u2713 %s\n", msg)) }
  else { fails <<- c(fails, msg); cat(sprintf("  \u2717 %s\n      %s\n", msg, substr(detail, 1, 200))) }
}

run_gmr4 <- function(payload, tag) {
  i <- file.path(TMP, paste0(tag, ".json")); o <- paste0(i, ".out"); e <- paste0(i, ".err")
  writeLines(jsonlite::toJSON(payload, auto_unbox = TRUE), i)
  st <- system2(RSCRIPT, c(GMR4, shQuote(i), shQuote(o), shQuote(e)), stdout = FALSE, stderr = FALSE)
  if (st != 0) return(list(code = st, err = if (file.exists(e)) paste(readLines(e, warn = FALSE), collapse = " ") else ""))
  list(code = 0, out = jsonlite::fromJSON(o, simplifyVector = FALSE))
}

set.seed(11L)
mk_truth <- function(n, p, q, S, snr = 0.15) {
  X <- matrix(rnorm(n * p), n)
  B <- matrix(rnorm(p * S), p) %*% matrix(rnorm(S * q), S)      # 精确秩 S
  Y <- X %*% B + matrix(rnorm(n * q, 0, snr), n)
  list(X = X, Y = Y, B = B)
}

cat("\n\u2500\u2500 1. 恒等式：满秩 + lambda≈0 必须等于逐响应 OLS \u2500\u2500\n")
{
  tr <- mk_truth(60, 4, 5, 2)
  r <- run_gmr4(list(X = tr$X, Y = tr$Y, ranks = c(4), lambdas = c(1e-8)), "identity")
  ok(r$code == 0, "引擎跑通", r$err %||% "")
  if (r$code == 0) {
    Bstd <- r*out$coefficients
    # 用标准化后的 X/Y 跑 lm，系数应与闭式解一致（在标准化尺度上）
    Xs <- scale(tr$X); Ys <- scale(tr$Y)
    ols <- sapply(1:5, function(j) coef(lm.fit(Xs, Ys[, j]))[-1])
    ok(max(abs(Bstd - ols)) < 1e-6, "满秩 lambda->0 的 B 逐元素等于 OLS",
       paste(dim(Bstd), collapse = "x "))
    ok(isTRUE(all.equal(as.numeric(r$out$R2_per_response),
                        sapply(1:5, function(j) summary(lm(Ys[, j] ~ Xs))$r.squared), tol = 1e-6)),
       "各响应 R2 等于对应 lm() 的 R2")
  }
}

cat("\n\u2500\u2500 2. 恒等式：满秩时必须等于岭解 (X'X+lambda I)^-1 X'Y \u2500\u2500\n")
{
  tr <- mk_truth(60, 4, 5, 2)
  lam <- 2.5
  r <- run_gmr4(list(X = tr$X, Y = tr$Y, ranks = c(4), lambdas = c(lam)), "ridgelink")
  if (r$code == 0) {
    Xs <- scale(tr$X); Ys <- scale(tr$Y)
    Bring <- as.matrix(solve(crossprod(Xs) + lam * diag(4), crossprod(Xs, Ys)))
    ok(max(abs(r$out$coefficients - Bring)) < 1e-6, "满秩 S=min(p,q) 的 B 等于岭回归解",
       paste("max|diff| =", format(max(abs(r$out$coefficients - Bring)), digits = 3)))
  } else ok(FALSE, "满秩岭对照跑通", r$err)
}

cat("\n\u2500\u2500 3. 单调性：秩越低，训练 RSS 越大 \u2500\u2500\n")
{
  tr <- mk_truth(60, 5, 6, 3)
  rs <- lapply(1:5, function(S) run_gmr4(list(X = tr$X, Y = tr$Y, ranks = c(S), lambdas = c(0.1)), paste0("mono", S)))
  rss <- sapply(rs, function(x) if (x$code == 0) x$out$rss_reduced else NA_real_)
  ok(all(is.finite(rss)) && all(diff(rss) <= 1e-8), "RSS(S) 随 S 上升而不增",
     paste(round(rss, 3), collapse = " -> "))
}

cat("\n\u2500\u2500 4. 统计下限：真实秩 3，选型必须找回 3 \u2500\u2500\n")
{
  seeds <- c(101, 202, 303)
  got <- sapply(seeds, function(sd) {
    set.seed(sd); tr <- mk_truth(80, 6, 9, 3, snr = 0.1)
    r <- run_gmr4(list(X = tr$X, Y = tr$Y, seed = sd), paste0("recover", sd))
    if (r$code == 0) r$out$rank_selected else NA_integer_
  })
  ok(all(got == 3), "3 个不同种子下广义 1-SE 规则都选中 S=3", paste(got, collapse = ", "))
}

cat("\u2500\u2500 5. 小样本必须拒绝，不能给荒谬系数 \u2500\u2500\n")
{
  tr <- mk_truth(2, 3, 3, 2)
  r <- run_gmr4(list(X = tr$X, Y = tr$Y), "tiny")
  ok(r$code != 0 && grepl("至少需要 4 个样本", r$err), "n=2 被拒绝且说清原因", r$err)
}

cat("\u2500\u2500 6. 退化输入的诊断（常量列 / p>=n / 方阵形状）\u2500\u2500\n")
{
  tr <- mk_truth(40, 4, 5, 2)
  Xc <- tr$X; Xc[, 3] <- 7                       # 常量列
  r <- run_gmr4(list(X = Xc, Y = tr$Y), "constcol")
  ok(r$code == 0 && length(r$out$diagnostics) >= 1 &&
       any(grepl("常量列", unlist(r$out$diagnostics))), "常量列被剔除并报告",
     paste(unlist(r$out$diagnostics), collapse = " | "))
  r2 <- run_gmr4(list(X = matrix(rnorm(6 * 6), 6), Y = tr$Y[, 1:5]), "squareX")
  ok(r2$code != 0 && grepl("方阵", r2$err), "6x6 方阵形状的 X 被拒（像距离矩阵）", r2$err)
  r3 <- run_gmr4(list(X = as.vector(tr$X), Y = tr$Y), "flatvec")
  ok(r3$code != 0 && grepl("一维数组", r3$err), "一维数组被拒并说明要二维", r3$err)
}

cat("\u2500\u2500 7. 协变量必须被偏正交化掉（Frisch-Waugh）\u2500\u2500\n")
{
  set.seed(9L); n <- 120
  Z <- matrix(rnorm(n), n)
  X <- matrix(rnorm(n * 3), n) + Z               # X 与 Z 强共线
  B <- matrix(rnorm(3 * 2), 3) %*% matrix(rnorm(2 * 4), 2)
  Y <- X %*% B + 4 * Z + matrix(rnorm(n * 4, 0, .05), n)   # Z 对 Y 有强直接效应
  a <- run_gmr4(list(X = X, Y = Y, ranks = c(2), lambdas = c(0.01)), "z_on")
  b <- run_gmr4(list(X = X, Y = Y, Z = Z, ranks = c(2), lambdas = c(0.01)), "z_off")
  if (a$code == 0 && b$code == 0) {
    r2_nocov <- a$out$R2; r2_cov <- b$out$R2
    ok(abs(r2_cov) < abs(r2_nocov) || b$out$covariates_partialled_out == 1,
       "带 Z 时确实偏掉了 1 个协变量", sprintf("R2 无Z=%.4f 有Z=%.4f", r2_nocov, r2_cov))
    ok(max(abs(a$out$coefficients - b$out$coefficients)) > 1e-6,
       "偏正交化确实改变了 B（不是原样返回）",
       paste("max|diff| =", format(max(abs(a$out$coefficients - b$out$coefficients)), digits = 3)))
  } else ok(FALSE, "Z 两条都跑通", paste(a$err, b$err))
}

cat("\u2500\u2500 8. 可复现：同输入两次必须逐字节相同 \u2500\u2500\n")
{
  tr <- mk_truth(50, 4, 5, 2)
  a <- run_gmr4(list(X = tr$X, Y = tr$Y), "rep1")
  b <- run_gmr4(list(X = tr$X, Y = tr$Y), "rep2")
  fa <- paste(readLines(paste0(file.path(TMP, "rep1.json"), ".out"), warn = FALSE), collapse = "")
  fb <- paste(readLines(paste0(file.path(TMP, "rep2.json"), ".out"), warn = FALSE), collapse = "")
  ok(a$code == 0 && identical(fa, fb), "两次运行的输出 JSON 完全一致", "存在随机性未固定")
}

cat("\u2500\u2500 9. 契约字段齐全（视图与 L3 要读的东西）\u2500\u2500\n")
{
  tr <- mk_truth(50, 4, 5, 2)
  r <- run_gmr4(list(X = tr$X, Y = tr$Y), "contract")
  need <- c("success", "method", "n_samples", "p", "q", "rank_selected", "lambda_selected",
            "rank_grid", "lambda_grid", "s_max", "kfold", "seed", "selection_rule",
            "coefficients", "coefficients_raw_scale", "U", "V", "R2", "R2_per_response",
            "cv", "rss_reduced", "rss_full", "covariates_partialled_out",
            "X_center", "X_scale", "Y_center", "predicted", "diagnostics", "interpretation")
  if (r$code == 0) {
    miss <- setdiff(need, names(r$out))
    ok(length(miss) == 0, "输出契约字段齐全", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
    ok(nrow(r$out$predicted) == 50 && ncol(r$out$predicted) == 5, "predicted 形状 = n x q",
       paste(dim(as.matrix(r$out$predicted)), collapse = "x"))
    ok(nrow(as.matrix(r$out$coefficients)) == 4 && ncol(as.matrix(r$out$coefficients)) == 5,
       "coefficients 形状 = p x q")
  } else ok(FALSE, "契约检查跑通", r$err)
}

import io
p=r"r-scripts/gmr4.R"

# 1) solve_or_reg：先精确解，失败才加岭，并回报加了多少
old='''rrr_ridge_fit <- function(Xc, Yc, rank_s, lambda) {'''
new='''# 先按精确 Cholesky 解；只在真奇异时才逐步加岭，并回报加了多少。
# 不要"为了稳定"无条件预加一个小岭：那样会把 满秩+lambda=0 必须等于 OLS
# 这条恒等式污染掉（实测 |B-B_ols| 稳定在 1e-5，与 lambda 无关，就是它）。
solve_or_reg <- function(A, B, trace_scale = 1) {
  r <- tryCatch(chol(as.matrix(A)), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(r)) return(list(x = backsolve(r, backsolve(r, B, transpose = TRUE), k = ncol(B)), ridge = 0))
  step <- max(1e-10, 1e-8 * trace_scale)
  for (i in 1:8) {
    rr <- tryCatch(chol(as.matrix(A + step * diag(nrow(A)))), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(rr)) {
      return(list(x = backsolve(rr, backsolve(rr, B, transpose = TRUE), k = ncol(B)), ridge = step))
    }
    step <- step * 10
  }
  stop("矩阵过度奇异（连续加了 8 级正则仍无法求逆）—— 请减少变量或增加样本", call. = FALSE)
}

old2='''  B_ridge <- safe_solve(Sxx, Sxy, ridge = lambda)              # (X'X+λI)^-1 X'Y

  M <- safe_solve(Syy, crossprod(Sxy, B_ridge), ridge = 1e-8 * max(1, sum(diag(Syy)) / q))'''

  # 广义特征问题 M = Syy^-1 * Sxy' B —— 它的领先 S 个特征向量给出响应侧的投影方向 V。
  # Syy 只有在真奇异（例如 q > n 或有冗余响应列）时才需要正则，见 solve_or_reg。
  sm <- solve_or_reg(Syy, crossprod(Sxy, B_ridge), trace_scale = sum(diag(Syy)) / q)

  syy_ridge_used <- sm$ridge'''
assert old2 in s

old3='''    stop(sprintf("%s 不是矩阵（拿到的类型是 %s）", what, typeof(m)), call. = FALSE)'''

# 把引擎里的两个 helper 原样搬进来，进程内直接比，绕开 JSON 往返
safe_solve <- function(A, B = NULL, ridge = 0) {
  Areg <- A; if (ridge > 0) Areg <- A + ridge * diag(nrow(A))
  out <- tryCatch(chol2inv(chol(as.matrix(Areg))), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(out)) stop("singular")
  if (is.null(B)) out else out %*% B
}
solve_or_reg <- function(A, B, trace_scale = 1) {
  r <- tryCatch(chol(as.matrix(A)), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(r)) return(list(x = chol2inv(r) %*% B, ridge = 0))
  step <- max(1e-10, 1e-8 * trace_scale)
  for (i in 1:8) { rr <- tryCatch(chol(as.matrix(A + step*diag(nrow(A)))), error=function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(rr)) return(list(x = chol2inv(rr) %*% B, ridge = step)); step <- step*10 }
  stop("too singular")
}
rrr_ridge_fit <- function(Xc, Yc, rank_s, lambda) {
  p <- ncol(Xc); q <- ncol(Yc)
  Sxx <- crossprod(Xc); Sxy <- crossprod(Xc, Yc); Syy <- crossprod(Yc)
  B_ridge <- safe_solve(Sxx, Sxy, ridge = lambda)
  sm <- solve_or_reg(Syy, crossprod(Sxy, B_ridge), trace_scale = sum(diag(Syy)) / q); M <- sm$x
  ev <- eigen(M, symmetric = FALSE); ord <- order(-Re(ev$values))
  V <- Re(ev$vectors[, ord[seq_len(min(rank_s, q))], drop = FALSE])
  G <- safe_solve(crossprod(V, Syy %*% V))
  B <- B_ridge %*% V %*% G %*% t(V) %*% Syy
  list(B = B, V = V, syy_ridge_used = sm$ridge)
}
